ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT May , 2005, by and between Lewis F. Davis ("Davis"), Philip Hirsch ("Hirsch") and Margaret Illes Arnoczy,individually and as executrixunder thelastwill and testamentofFrank Illes (Arnoczy": Davis, Hirsch and Arnoczy, when referred to herein collectively, are referred                 LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Herzfeld & Rubin, P.C., 40 Wall Street, NewYork,NewYork 10005(hereinafter referred to as“Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner infee title of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,in theCountyofNewYork,CityandStateofNewYork,known as and by the street address 14 West 19th Street and the tax lot Block 820,Lot 54 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as “Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter WHEREAS, Developer has a fee ownership interest in a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 16West19th Street and the taxlot Block820,Lot 55 and moreparticularly describedinExhibit A-2annexed hereto and made apart thereof(said land and tax lot being referred to herein as “Developer's Land"; and said land and buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof and any other adjacent land and buildings and improvements hereinafter acquired by Developer or any affiliates thereof, being hereinafter referred to as“Developer's Property"); WHEREAS,Developer intends,either through Developer or an affiliate thereof either (i) to construct a new building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land and other adjacent land and/or (i) to alter the existing building(s) located on Developer's Land (said new and/or altered building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"; Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as “Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the “Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent“zoning lot",with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and Owner's Land into a single “zoning lot” for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with such limitation;
